_source: LCBT course finder logic v1-updated.xlsx - sheet 'logic', rows 19-75, reconciled against the live catalogue at lcbt.co.uk/courses (7 Sept 2026). The sheet's hidden rows 12-14 define separate '19+ Level 3' courses that do not exist on the live site: there is one Level 3 diploma per subject, open to both age groups with different funding. The 19+ rules below therefore resolve to l3-* rather than to separate 19+ course records. Rules are evaluated top to bottom; the first whose `when` clause matches wins. Decks are no longer topped up with a 'see all' card: client feedback (LCBT Quiz Feedback, 9 Sept 2026) was that browsing all courses should not be a swipeable card. The route out now sits on the results panel instead. The 'business' rows: the sheet specifies them only for 16-18 with no previous qualification (rows 29-30). Every other rule's business row repeats its 'all' row as a placeholder until LCBT confirms what those learners should see (questions sent 10 Nov 2026).

rules.note: Sheet rows 19-30: 16-18, no previous qualification -> recommend Level 2. Rows 29-30 add Level 2 Beauty Business & Retail for the two business cards; their 'Explore all Level 2 courses' alternative stays off the deck (see _source; LCBT confirmed 11 Nov 2026 to keep it as the results-panel link). The 'all' row adds Level 2 Beauty Business & Retail last, which is not in the sheet: LCBT confirmed it on 11 Nov 2026.

Sheet rows 32-39: 16-18 holding a Level 2 -> recommend Level 3. Row 39 recommends all three Level 3s only "until we know which level 2 they hold" - the subject question now narrows this to the ones they are eligible for (see admits() in matching.ts).
Sheet rows 42-49: 19+, no previous qualification -> short courses if available.
Sheet rows 42-49, alternative column: nothing available -> register interest only.
Sheet rows 51-57: 19+ holding a Level 2, short courses exist. Row 54 (beauty) now offers Level 3 Hair and Media Make-Up in place of Level 4 Aesthetic Practice.
Sheet rows 59-65: 19+ holding a Level 2, short courses do not exist. Row 62 (beauty) adds Level 3 Hair and Media Make-Up.
Screen copy s.5 'No-match variant': 19+ whose level could not be confirmed -> register interest.
